headline: JSA advises Renew Surya Roshni on securing $730 million for 320 MW RTC project
sum: Renew Surya Roshni Private Limited has availed an external commercial borrowing of $730 million from a consortium of twelve banks comprising Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Standard Chartered Bank, Société Générale, Bank of America,…
detail: Renew Surya Roshni Private Limited has availed an external commercial borrowing of $730 million from a consortium of twelve banks comprising Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Standard Chartered Bank, Société Générale, Bank of America, NA, DBS Bank Ltd., ING Bank NV., MUFG Bank, Ltd., Mizuho Bank, Ltd., Taipei Fubon Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., Qatar National Bank, Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank, and CTBC Bank Co Limited. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Renew Surya Roshni on this transaction.
